text: Gopika Nair J is a Computer Science Engineer working as a Junior Generative AI Engineer at Raabyt, based in Kerala, India. She builds agentic AI systems — conversational interfaces, report generators and RAG pipelines — that turn large language models into software people actually use inside an enterprise.

Gopika describes herself as adaptable and self-motivated. She picks things up quickly, communicates clearly, and takes commitment seriously — deadlines, teams, and the parts of a project nobody volunteers for. She believes learning goes beyond textbooks, and most of what she is good at she picked up by doing.

You can reach Gopika by email at nairjgopika@gmail.com or by phone on +91 99616 65142. She is on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/gopika-nair-j and GitHub at github.com/gopikanj03. She is based in Kerala, India, and is open to relocating.

Gopika is open to Generative AI and Machine Learning opportunities. She is looking for work where she can keep growing and make a real difference, and is always happy to talk about agents, RAG, or anything LLM-shaped.

Gopika has three roles to date: Junior Generative AI Engineer at Raabyt, her current position building the AI layer of an on-premise ERP; a one-month Data Analyst traineeship at MedTourEasy in September 2025; and a ten-day Python and Machine Learning internship at Revertech IT Solutions in 2023.

Gopika is a Junior Generative AI Engineer at Raabyt, her current role. She works on an on-premise ERP product. The base product was capable but much like any other ERP on the market — the AI layer is what differentiates it, and that layer is her work.

At Raabyt, Gopika built a conversational search agent for the ERP — an agentic AI workflow that lets a user ask questions across the entire system in plain language. One prompt replaces knowing which screen to open, which makes the system far easier to use. It is built with LangGraph and LLMs.

Gopika built an automated report generator for the Raabyt ERP. A user describes the report they want in plain language and the system builds it, however complex the underlying query is. It removes the need to construct reports by hand.

Gopika built adaptive lead scoring into the Raabyt ERP. Lead scores re-calculate themselves automatically as customer responses land — positive or negative — weighed against the other signals on the account, so the score always reflects the account as it is now rather than when it was last edited by hand.

Gopika performed AI-assisted data migration at Raabyt, moving legacy data into the ERP with AI handling the field mapping. She describes it as the hardest part of the job and the least visible — technically demanding work that users never see directly.

Alongside the Gen AI features, Gopika builds and integrates machine learning models for classification, forecasting and anomaly detection into the Raabyt ERP workflows, placing the output where business decisions actually get made.

In September 2025 Gopika completed a one-month Data Analyst traineeship at MedTourEasy, working hands-on across the full data-analysis workflow. She developed a machine learning model using Python, Pandas and TPOT to forecast blood-donation behaviour from donor data.
In 2023 Gopika completed a ten-day internship at Revertech IT Solutions Pvt Ltd, covering the fundamentals of Python and Machine Learning.

Gopika has built three main projects: the Smart Travel Planner (April 2026), an agentic AI trip-planning workflow; the Mini RAG System (December 2025), a retrieval-augmented question answering system over PDFs; and DeepHire (April 2025), a real-time AI mock interview platform built as her final-year major project.

Smart Travel Planner (April 2026) is an agentic AI workflow that parses natural-language trip queries and orchestrates tool calls to answer them. It composes weather, places and route APIs into real-time recommendations, served through a Streamlit UI. Built with FastAPI, LangGraph and Gemma via Ollama. Repository: github.com/gopikanj03/travel_planner

Mini RAG System (December 2025) is a retrieval-augmented question answering system. It ingests PDF documents, generates semantic embeddings with all-MiniLM-L6-v2, stores them in ChromaDB, and retrieves relevant context for grounded answers. It is wired to Groq Llama 3.1 8B Instant through LangChain for low-latency responses. Repository: github.com/gopikanj03/Answer-Generator-

DeepHire (April 2025) was Gopika's major final-year project: a real-time AI mock interview platform. It generates questions and evaluates answers with Gemini AI, reads candidate emotion through DeepFace, and scores spoken fluency using spaCy, combining all three into live interview feedback. Repository: github.com/gopikanj03/deephire-ai-interviewer

Gopika's skills span five areas: Generative AI and LLMs (RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, AI agents, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases); machine learning and deep learning (Python, PyTorch, NLP, Scikit-learn); data and analytics (SQL, Pandas, NumPy, EDA, data visualisation); tools and platforms (FastAPI, Git, Tableau, Power BI, R); and leadership and communication.
Gopika's Generative AI and LLM skills cover RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, AI agents, agentic AI development, prompt engineering, embeddings and vector databases.
In machine learning and deep learning Gopika works with Python, machine learning, deep learning, NLP, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, TPOT, logistic regression, algorithms and data structures.

Gopika's data and analytics skills include data analysis, exploratory data analysis, data science, Pandas, NumPy, SQL, MySQL, data cleaning, data manipulation, data processing, data validation, data visualization, data storytelling, data ethics, business analytics and data-driven decision making.
Tools and platforms Gopika uses: FastAPI, Git, AI coding assistants, Tableau, Power BI, R, C, Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word.

Gopika's leadership and communication skills include leadership, team leadership, management, communication, technical communication, public speaking, presentation skills, teamwork, project management, project planning, analytical skills, report writing, documentation and workflow management.

Gopika holds a BTech in Computer Science and Engineering from College of Engineering Adoor, completed in May 2025 with a CGPA of 7.8. She completed Higher Secondary Education at Govt. TDHSS, Alappuzha in March 2021 with 98.33 percent.

Gopika holds 30 certifications in total, all through Coursera: 16 from IBM and 14 from Google. The headline credentials are the IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate (June 2026, covering 15 courses) and the Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate (August 2025, covering 9 courses), plus four course certificates from Google Advanced Data Analytics.

Gopika's IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate covers 16 credentials, including Fundamentals of AI Agents Using RAG and LangChain, Generative AI Advanced Fine-Tuning for LLMs, Generative AI Engineering and Fine-Tuning Transformers, Generative AI Language Modeling with Transformers, Gen AI Foundational Models for NLP, Generative AI and LLMs Architecture and Data Preparation, Building Generative AI-Powered Applications with Python, Prompt Engineering Basics, Introduction to Deep Learning and Neural Networks with Keras, Machine Learning with Python, Data Analysis with Python, and Developing AI Applications with Python and Flask.

Gopika's Google credentials date from August 2025. She holds the Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate, which covers nine courses: Foundations Data Data Everywhere; Ask Questions to Make Data-Driven Decisions; Prepare Data for Exploration; Process Data from Dirty to Clean; Analyze Data to Answer Questions; Share Data Through the Art of Visualization; Data Analysis with R Programming; the Google Data Analytics Capstone case study; and Accelerate Your Job Search with AI. She also holds four individual course certificates from the Google Advanced Data Analytics programme: Foundations of Data Science, Get Started with Python, Go Beyond the Numbers, and The Power of Statistics.

Gopika spent 2 years 9 months with the National Service Scheme at College of Engineering Adoor. She was Senior Mentor for the NRPF KLM-PTA Region from January 2024 to September 2025, Associate Volunteer Secretary in 2023–2024, and NRPF Regional Coordinator for the KLM-PTA Region in 2023–2024.

Gopika spent 2 years 2 months with the IEEE Student Branch at College of Engineering Adoor. She was Secretary from January 2023 to February 2024, and Secretary of the WiE (Women in Engineering) Affinity Group in 2022–2023.
